Method of Attack: Encrypts files on the compromised machine and demands ransom for file decryption
Attack Vector: Files will be encrypted and changed to have a “.darky” file extension, with a ransom note named “Restore-My-Files.txt” deposited in the location of encrypted files
Indicators of Compromise: 0.005BTC (approximately $120.00USD) to decrypt the files on an affected system

Method of Attack: Encrypts files on compromised machines and adds a file extension named after the target company to the affected files
Attack Vector: An MSI (Windows installer) file is delivered to the target machine containing a Windows DLL file that requires specific criteria to execute
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom note with a unique ID and contact information for the operators

Method of Attack: Encrypts files on a victim’s machine and demands a price of $980USD to have software provided to decrypt the affected files
Attack Vector: Ransomware appends a ‘.vvyu’ file extension to encrypted files and deposits a ransom note in every location where files are encrypted
Indicators of Compromise: $980USD ransom demand, support e-mail addresses, and a unique ID provided in the ransom note

Method of Attack: Encrypts files of interest on a victim machine and demands a ransom of $300USD worth of Bitcoin to be sent to a wallet controlled by the malware authors
Attack Vector: Encrypts files and appends a “.Kriptor” file extension, with a ransom note and a countdown timer for increased ransom demands
Indicators of Compromise: $300USD worth of Bitcoin (0.012BTC) to be sent to a wallet controlled by the malware authors

Method of Attack: Uses the 'double extortion' method of threatening to release a victim’s data on the Internet if they do not pay the requested ransom
Attack Vector: Encrypts files and appends a ‘.cuba’ file extension, with a ransom note named “!! READ ME !!.txt” deposited in directories where files are encrypted
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom note with a unique ID and contact information for the operators via Tox or backup email
